LanguageData.WFL_ModuleInactive_wils_treasury: Accounts, payroll and taxation are inactive; the saved accounts are kept.
LanguageData.WFL_TreasuryZoneDesc: Paint the Treasury: an enclosed room with a table, a chair or stool, and storage that accepts silver.
LanguageData.WFL_TZ_Reserves: Silver in storage: {0}. Other valuables: about {1} silver. Free storage slots: {2}.
LanguageData.WFL_TZ_Deposits: Silver waiting to be deposited: {0} in {1} stack(s).
LanguageData.WFL_TZ_MissingSilver: Accounts claim {0} more silver than is in storage.
LanguageData.WFL_TZ_Secondary: A treasury already exists on this map; this zone is not used.
LanguageData.WFL_TZ_ExpandDesc: Paint more cells into this treasury zone. Tables, seats and shelves can be painted over.
LanguageData.WFL_TZ_OpenDesc: Open the Treasury page of the Community window.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Valuables: Recognised valuables (stored wealth, never spendable silver)
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_ValuablesHint: Tick any item or resource that counts as stored wealth. Silver is always the spendable currency.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Claims: All accounts together hold {0} silver of claims; {1} silver is physically in storage.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Discrepancy: {0} silver of the accounts is not backed by silver that can be found (usable now: {1}). Everyone keeps what they own, but spending is limited until it is found or the loss is accepted.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Surplus: {0} silver in storage belongs to nobody yet. It becomes community funds if it stays unclaimed.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Unbacked: {0} silver that accounts own cannot be found. Nobody loses their balance, but spending is reduced until it is recovered.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Wealth: Personal and household wealth: {0} silver in {1} accounts.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_NextPayday: Next payday: {0} days away. Wages earned and waiting: {1} silver.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_NoZone: none yet (accounts and payroll work without one)
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_TransferFailed: That transfer could not be made ({0}).
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_WealthPayTitle: Pay linked to the colony's wealth
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_WealthPayShare: Share of the colony's wealth paid out as wages each year: {0}%
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_WealthPayOff: Off. Wages use the fixed rates below.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_WealthPayOn: On. The colony is worth {0} silver, so each payday's wage pool is about {1} silver, shared by the work done. Pay rises and falls with the colony.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_WealthGapLine: Colonists hold {0} silver on average against {1} of the colony's wealth each ({2}%).
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_GapMood: Colonists mind being far poorer than the colony
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_GapMoodNote: When a colonist holds only a tiny share of the colony's wealth per colonist, they feel left out: a small mood penalty, stronger the wider the gap. Only counts once the colony is worth about 1,500 silver per colonist. It never changes any balance.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_PayrollHelp: Wages are paid on the 1st and 8th of every quadrum from the treasury, for finished work by people assigned to a profession. If the money is short everyone receives the same share and the rest stays owed. Payroll never creates silver.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_DailyCap: Most any one person can earn in a day
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_VanillaWork: Ordinary labour: paid for finished work only, and only while the treasury can cover what is already owed
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_OrdinaryCap: Most ordinary labour can earn one person in a day
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_WageComplaint: {0} workers have not been paid in full for several paydays. {1} silver in wages is owed. They are asking the community leadership to settle it.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_FundingTitle: When the treasury cannot cover payroll
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Funding_Proportional: Pay everyone the same share; the rest stays owed
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Funding_Manual: My own order (use the arrows below)
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_FundingNote: Payroll only ever uses the community treasury. Household and personal savings are never touched. Unpaid wages stay owed in full.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Renegotiate: Offer lower rates from now on (-25%)
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_RenegotiateNote: Only future work is paid at the new rates. Wages already earned stay owed in full.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Owned: Owned by accounts: {0}. Can be spent now: {1}. Silver that cannot be found: {2}.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Bearer: The community treasury bears the shortage first ({0} silver). {1} is spread over households and people in proportion to what they own. Nobody loses ownership; if the silver is found, spending is restored.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_WagesOwedTotal: Wages owed to workers: {0} silver ({1} workers unpaid for 2 or more paydays).
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_TaxLocked: Taxation is locked. Assign a qualified Tax Collector (Professions page) to unlock it. Until then the community may keep a share of income, but that is not a tax.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_IncomeShare: Share of rewards the community keeps: {0}%
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Adopted: {0} silver that was already in storage has been recorded as community funds. Nothing was given to anyone.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Lost: {0} silver that the accounts claimed is no longer in storage (stolen, destroyed or lost). It was removed from the community treasury, and the loss is in the transaction history.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Payday: Payday: {0} silver was due and {1} was paid.{2}
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_RewardShared: A reward of {0} silver was shared: the community kept {1}.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Caught: {0} left some income out, but the collector noticed and the full amount was paid.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Outcome_Partial: paid part of what was owed
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Event_embezzles: Part of a collection did not reach the treasury.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Event_demands_more: The collector asked for more than was authorised.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Event_accepts_bribe: The collector took a payment to look the other way.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Event_reports_missing_funds: Missing funds were found and reported; the amount is now owed back.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Event_corruption_accusation: Some in the community accuse the collector of corruption.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Event_fair_treatment: The collector's even-handedness has been noticed.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Event_returns_money: The collector returned money that should not have been taken.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_Event_community_petition: A petition about the collection is going round.
LanguageData.WFL_Need_Wages: Silver to pay wages: the last payday fell short

LanguageData.WFL_Tr_BudgetHelp: The wage bill by module. Staff is how many people hold a role from that module; Earned is what they have earned and not yet been paid; Daily max is the most their roles could cost per day if everyone worked to the limit. Nothing here moves silver.
LanguageData.WFL_Tr_BudgetNone: Nobody is on the payroll yet.

LanguageData.WFL_Health_Tr_LowHint: See the Budget tab for who costs what.
